description: This file declares a function for constructing an AT command related to security algorithms in the Cuttlefish project. It includes a function prototype for generating the command string based on connection event parameters and security attributes, intended for use in the Android Open Source Project's Cuttlefish device emulator.

methods.name: GetATCommand
methods.description: Constructs an AT command string to update the security algorithm information reported by Cuttlefish's RIL, triggering unsolicited security updates.
